en: Revenue rose 25% to $127.6B, a touch below the ~$128.2B consensus, and GAAP EPS of $2.12 missed about $3.02 after an $8.7B loss on equity stakes. Google Cloud was the standout again: revenue up 103% to $30.7B with a 36.2% margin, helped by TPU system sales. Search grew 12% and YouTube ads 9%, both slower than in Q2. CFO Anat Ashkenazi kept the $195–205B capex plan and said 2027 will rise significantly. Sundar Pichai cited huge AI demand and said Alphabet is racing to add capacity.

Shares closed up 1.3% at $324.89 before the report and fell about 10% after hours. In the first session, on Oct 29, they closed down 12.6% at $283.82, the worst day since Alphabet listed, erasing about $500B of market value. Free cash flow of −$9.1B against about −$2.7B expected, Search growth slowing to 12% and a messy call outweighed the Cloud beat; the drop pulled the Nasdaq down 1.4%.
zh: 营收增长 25% 至 1,276 亿美元，略低于约 1,282 亿美元的市场预期；因股权投资亏损 87 亿美元，GAAP 每股收益 2.12 美元，不及约 3.02 美元预期。谷歌云再度领跑：营收增长 103% 至 307 亿美元，利润率 36.2%，TPU 系统销售助力明显。搜索增长 12%、YouTube 广告增长 9%，均较第二季放缓。CFO 阿纳特·阿什肯纳齐维持 1,950–2,050 亿美元的资本开支计划，并表示 2027 年将显著增加。桑达尔·皮查伊称 AI 需求巨大，公司正全力扩充产能。
财报前股价收涨 1.3% 至 324.89 美元，盘后下跌约 10%。首个交易日（10 月 29 日）收跌 12.6% 至 283.82 美元，为上市以来最差单日表现，市值蒸发约 5,000 亿美元。自由现金流 −91 亿美元（预期约 −27 亿）、搜索增速放缓至 12%，加上表现欠佳的电话会议，盖过了云业务的亮眼成绩；这一跌幅拖累纳斯达克指数下跌 1.4%。

bio.en: Joined Google in 2004 and led Chrome, Chrome OS and Android. CEO of Google since 2015 and of Alphabet since 2019; now steering about $200B a year of capex into Gemini, Google Cloud and custom TPU chips.
bio.zh: 2004 年加入谷歌，曾主导 Chrome、Chrome OS 与安卓。2015 年起任谷歌 CEO，2019 年起兼任 Alphabet CEO；目前每年投入约 2,000 亿美元资本开支于 Gemini、谷歌云和自研 TPU 芯片。

bio.en: CFO since July 2024. Spent more than two decades at Eli Lilly, the last years as CFO, with a reputation for cost discipline. Owns Alphabet's capex guidance, which she raised to $195–205B for 2026.
bio.zh: 2024 年 7 月起任 CFO。此前在礼来工作二十多年，最后几年任 CFO，以成本管控著称。负责 Alphabet 资本开支指引，并将 2026 年指引上调至 1,950–2,050 亿美元。
